title: The Digital Revolution of the Practice
subtitle: Dr Rachid & Dr Samia Count on You
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 

Dr Rachid has just acquired an intraoral scanner. He is fascinated by this technology that promises to revolutionize his practice. But he quickly discovers that CAD/CAM is a complex universe.

Between scanners, CAD, CAM, machining, 3D printing, file formats and surgical guides… the path is full of pitfalls.

A design error, a wrong material, and the prosthesis fails. 

The precision of restorations, patient satisfaction, and the practice's reputation rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: The Digital Revolution of the Practice - Dr Rachid has just acquired an intraoral scanner. He is fascinated by this technology that promises to revolutionize his practice. But he quickly discovers that CAD/CAM is a complex universe.
chapters.debutant2: The Foundations of CAD/CAM - Dr Rachid and Dr Samia explore the basics of CAD/CAM. They discover intraoral scanners, CAD software and machining machines. Each step of the digital workflow is a discovery.
chapters.intermediaire1: Mastering the Digital Workflow - Dr Rachid and Dr Samia now master optical impressions and CAD design. They must now optimize their workflow to gain efficiency and precision.
chapters.intermediaire2: Materials and Machining - Dr Rachid and Dr Samia explore CAD/CAM materials: zirconia, lithium disilicate, composites. They discover the secrets of machining and 3D printing.
chapters.expert1: Innovation and Management - Dr Rachid and Dr Samia become references in CAD/CAM. They innovate and train young dentists in this digital revolution. The future of the practice is digital.
chapters.expert2: Digital Excellence - After years of practice, Dr Rachid and Dr Samia pass on their knowledge to the new generation. CAD/CAM has become a tool at the service of the patient, driven by passion and innovation.
